body: First new-native-bundle run PID27392: calibration computed and encoded after launch, same indexed slot overwritten, native Read/Optimize/readiness reached, fresh peak/channel/ridge visibly rendered (evidence/runtime/in-game/runtime_surface-27392-crash.png). Native crash during combined node-0 GetTerrainNodeData/GetTerrainHeightData stage; exact failing call unisolated. No gameplay rays/ground checks or replacements reached; c1-c3 unmet. Crash preserved, no telemetry submitted; owned process terminated after dialog No clicks did not close it. Both bulk-read calls removed from gameplay suite, not retried. Independent IL review: no managed callers in 70 pinned shipping assemblies; editor managed scan likewise gives no mode/payload proof. Classification unsupported in tested shipping lifecycle, not editor-only. Added progressive query-result publication/checkpointing so subsequent failures retain preceding measurements. Next run uses actual stock gameplay height/ground/ray paths, no node exports. Encoder offline 11956 checks and independent decoded match to prior rendered fixture remain valid.
